subject.title: fix(codex): prevent silent replies after session supersession

question: Should OpenClaw accept AgentHarnessSessionSupersededError as a permanent public generic harness-plugin contract for non-retryable ownership loss?
rationale: The fix needs core to distinguish an ownership fence from provider health, but exporting a new runtime SDK error commits external harness plugins to a durable contract that tests alone cannot define.

options.title: Adopt the generic harness contract
options.body: Accept the public error after real two-generation delivery proof confirms the narrow supersession path and no fallback behavior.

options.title: Keep the signal Codex-specific
options.body: Revise the boundary if maintainers do not want a new generic public error type in the plugin SDK.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic harness contract
recommendation.body: Accept the public error after real two-generation delivery proof confirms the narrow supersession path and no fallback behavior.
